## North star
Open Brain becomes the **first-class ambient agent-memory substrate** — the thing Honcho *used* to be (auto-capture, per-agent context, memory as a live source agents lean on every turn) — but **fully owned by our OB ruleset**, not Honcho's server-side model / someone else's rules. This is the substrate the always-on-OB gate (#303-family) and the autonomous factory (rtech-infra #304) both depend on. Ties to the fleet-hub CT274 honcho→fleet-hub migration.

## Why this epic exists
The work is REAL and committed (Rico's discipline: no session closes without commit/push/PR) but **scattered across repos/branches with no tracking epic**, and even the owner isn't sure where all of it landed ('I was in fleet-bus during a Wayfinder thing, shit might be all over the place'). Doing this archaeology by hand right now is tedious — which is itself the argument for the scout/project-hygiene reconciler (rtech-infra #304). This epic makes the north-star a tracked fact and gathers the pieces.
